title: Valid Parentheses
prompt: Given a string containing just the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid.
complexity_target: Use linear time and a stack-like structure.

title: Course Schedule
prompt: There are numCourses courses you have to finish, labeled from 0 to numCourses - 1. Given prerequisite pairs, return true if you can finish all courses.
complexity_target: Aim for O(V + E) time using indegrees or DFS cycle detection.

title: Clone Graph
prompt: Given a reference of a node in a connected undirected graph, return a deep copy of the graph.
constraints: The number of nodes is in the range [0, 100]

examples.output: A deep copy with the same adjacency relationships

complexity_target: Visit each node once and memoize already-cloned nodes.

title: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree
prompt: Design an algorithm to serialize a binary tree to a string and deserialize the string back to the original tree structure.
constraints: The number of nodes is in the range [0, 10000]

examples.output: Serialization and deserialization preserve the same tree

complexity_target: Use a representation that can be parsed in linear time.
